ache.title: An 8-fold banner, and a tier list to rank it
ache.note: Patch 2.5 runs an ‘8-folded’ banner: four characters and four Light Cones at once, then two more of each. Nero ranks priorities for FUA and DoT teams and signs off with ‘Good luck surviving Patch 2.5’. When even the guide says you need luck to survive a patch, the patch is the problem.
watch: priority lists for every team type
ache.tip: When a patch drops many banners, start by choosing none and see which you truly miss. Often the itch fades on its own.
lines: eight banners. I counted. I’m dizzy
you don’t have to survive a patch. skip it
tier lists rank banners, not your worth

textData.text: Inside the Loop: I made this while I was caught in the gacha loop. It stays up as a record of that time, not as advice.

In this video, I break down the upcoming Patch 2.5, which features an 8-folded banner including 4 characters and 4 Light Cones in the first part, with another 2 characters and 2 Light Cones in the second part. I discuss the priority of these additions for both FUA and DoT team compositions, evaluating characters like Feixiao, Robin, Kafka, and more. I'll give you insights on which characters and Light Cones to pull for, and how to make the most out of this patch. Whether you're an FUA or DoT fan, I've got you covered! Good luck surviving Patch 2.5.
